signals.text: One-page Squarespace site, stock photo, no quote form

bestTime: Tue to Thu, 7:30 to 8:30am, or 5 to 6:30pm

sections.label: Before you dial
sections.body:
Who: Liam, owner at Hughes Roofing, Bury St Edmunds.
Why them: the website is one Squarespace page with a stock photo and no quote form.
Best time: Tue to Thu, 7:30 to 8:30am, or 5 to 6:30pm.
Likely a sole trader: check the number against TPS before you dial. No cold texts until he's said yes on the call.
What you want: a 15-minute phone or video call. They're not local, so no pop-in.
Some of their Instagram posts look reposted from other roofers, so don't compliment the Instagram. Landline: 01284 750627.
Stand up, slow down on your name, and stop talking after every question.

sections.label: If someone else answers
sections.body:
Hi, it's Dean Finlayson, is Liam about?
_(if they ask what it's about)_ It's about how folk find Hughes Roofing online. Is Liam the right person for that, or is it someone else?
_(if Liam is out)_ No bother. When's the best time to catch them? _(write their name in the note)_

sections.label: Opener
sections.body:
Hi Liam, it's Dean Finlayson from Level One up in Scotland. _(slow)_
The reason I'm calling is your website. Is now OK for 30 seconds?
_(stop and wait)_
sections.original:

_(stop and wait)_

sections.label: Why I'm calling
sections.body:
It's one page with a stock photo and no way to ask for a quote. Anyone comparing roofers in Bury St Edmunds is going to ring whoever shows their own work.
_(if they say go on)_ How much of your work comes from people looking you up first?

sections.label: Questions
sections.body:
Q: Where do most of your new jobs come from just now?
Q: When someone hears about you and looks you up, where do they end up?
Q: Last time you lost a job to another firm, do you know why?
Listen for: word of mouth only, jobs going to firms that come up first on Google, people asking for photos of past work.

sections.label: If it's a problem for them
sections.body:
That's what I do. I build websites for trades that show off the work and make it easy to get a quote, so the folk searching find you, not the firm down the road.
I build it all myself, so you deal with me start to finish.

sections.label: The ask
sections.body:
Easier to show you than explain. Fifteen minutes on the phone, or a video call if that's easier. Tuesday at 8, or Thursday after 5, which is better?
_(if they hesitate)_ No commitment. If it's not for you, no bother at all.

sections.label: If they push back
sections.body:
They: We get enough work from word of mouth.
You: That's the best kind of work. The thing is, word of mouth still looks you up before they ring. What do they find when they do?

They: I'm not interested.
You: Fair enough, most folk aren't till they know why I'm calling. Quick one before I go: is getting found online something you've got covered?

They: Send me an email.
You: Will do. So I don't send you something you'll bin, what matters more to you right now, more enquiries or less time on the phone?

They: How much is it?
You: Depends what you need. It's a one-off build and then a small monthly. I'd rather show you first than throw a number at you. Fifteen minutes on the phone this week?

They: Don't call me again.
You: No problem, I'll take you off. Sorry for the interruption, all the best. _(Log as Do not call)_

sections.label: Voicemail
sections.body: Hi Liam, it's Dean Finlayson from Level One up in Scotland. I'm calling about your website and getting more quote requests from it. I'll try you again later in the week. You can get me back on this number. Again, it's Dean from Level One. Cheers.

sections.label: When they say yes
sections.body:
Brilliant. Let me read that back to you. _(say the day and time back)_ Is this the best number for you, or is there a mobile?
I'll text you now so you've got my number. I'll bring a couple of examples of a roofer's site with a quote form.

sections.body:
